rules.opaque_id_preservation: The upload id is copied unchanged into the export candidate column.
rules.sequence_alphabet: Sequences must be nonempty uppercase A, C, G and U. Lowercase bases, T, and other characters are rejected.
rules.unique_ids: Candidate upload ids are unique and nonempty. Reference upload ids are unique and nonempty.
rules.nullable_target_pdb_id: target_pdb_id may be blank when an unambiguous PDB is unavailable. A blank cell stays blank. ARP-1 does not replace it with a sentinel or an invented identifier. A nonempty value with leading or trailing whitespace is rejected. id stays nonempty and unique, sequence stays nonempty uppercase A/C/G/U, source_reference stays nonempty, and target_name stays nonempty in this corrected reference contract. Nullable PDB provenance preserves the full unique-core REF calibration set without inventing structural evidence.
rules.id_set_reconciliation: The expected candidate id set equals the candidate upload id set. Exported candidate ids plus explicit failure ids equal that set exactly.
rules.sequence_round_trip: The exported sequence is accepted only when it is character-for-character identical to the uploaded sequence for the same id.
rules.exported_length: The exported len integer equals the character length of the uploaded sequence and of the exported sequence.
rules.join: Rows are joined by candidate id. Row position is not a join key.
rules.duplicates_missing_extra: Duplicate, missing, and extra exported ids are rejected.
rules.nonfinite_tier1: A malformed or non-finite aptamer-likeness value is rejected. No score direction or threshold is applied.
rules.shuffle_profile: Shuffle tokens are accepted only for an explicitly selected synthetic run profile. No profile is inferred from the file.
rules.target_free_compatibility: Under the target-free profile the compatibility cell must be the observed literal only. That literal is not given a scientific meaning.
rules.failure_accounting: Every expected candidate is either one exported row or one explicit failure record with a nonempty reason. A missing export is not dropped and is not stored as zero.
rules.sha256: Every upload and every download is hashed with SHA-256 over its original bytes. The provenance record does not contain its own SHA-256. That digest is computed externally from the original provenance bytes and retained in the generated report SHA-256 block.
rules.schema_change: A header that differs in name, order, or membership fails closed. ARP-1 does not adapt the schema. A difference requires a reviewed specification revision.
rules.utf8_bom: One leading UTF-8 BOM is accepted. It is stripped only for decoding and logical header validation. The SHA-256 covers the original bytes. A BOM anywhere except the beginning of the byte stream is rejected. BOM handling is encoding normalization, not schema adaptation. Column name, order, and membership stay exact.
rules.no_combined_score: ARP-1 defines no combined Tier 1 and Tier 2 score.
rules.no_binding_interpretation: ARP-1 does not interpret binding, affinity, or selectivity.

sha256_requirements.rule: Hash the exact original bytes of every upload and every download. Do not hash a rewritten copy in place of those bytes. The provenance record stores the five hashes of the other fixture byte streams and does not store its own SHA-256.

provenance_record_schema.recorded_count_type: Recorded counts are nonnegative JSON integers. Booleans and floats are excluded, including floats that are mathematically integral.

raw_tier2_geometric_score.note: A provisional shortlist did not include a raw Tier 2 geometric score. That observation does not define the score as unavailable, and ARP-1 does not supply an equation, direction, or comparison scope.

target_configuration_fields.note: A target-free synthetic profile records the explicit sentinel on every textual target field. The structure hash is null because no structure file exists. ARP-1 does not invent a PDB identifier, a structure hash, or any other target configuration.

schema_change_policy: A header that differs in name, order, or membership from this draft fails closed. ARP-1 does not rename, reorder, add, or drop columns to accept the file. A single leading UTF-8 BOM is encoding normalization, not schema adaptation: it is stripped only for decoding and logical header validation, and the SHA-256 covers the original bytes. A BOM anywhere else is rejected. A difference in column name, order, or membership requires a reviewed specification revision.

interpretation_boundary.statement: ARP-1 checks upload and export mechanics on synthetic fixtures only. It does not score binding, affinity, or selectivity, and it does not define a combined Tier 1 and Tier 2 score.
